value.rationale: Distinguishes observed spectral peak count from the number of exchanging conformers for the canonical, equal-rate, equally spaced reversible three-state chain. The complete two-threshold phase diagram is natural and experimentally interpretable for ideal exchange-narrowing diagnostics, has a sharp quartic boundary classification, and requires nontrivial cubic real-root control beyond reporting a generic resolvent. The scope is intentionally exact and no experimental linewidth robustness is asserted.
